basic_info.description: Gorgeous and Contemporary! This stunning 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom single-family semi-detached corner home spans 2,020 SQFT and was built in 2017, offering three stories of modern living. Enjoy outdoor entertaining on the deck and in the rear yard. Perched on a scenic hillside, Summit 800 presents an inspiring collection of San Francisco single-family homes like this one. This residence boasts innovative design and unique details, including high ceilings in the living area and master bedroom suites with large walk-in closets. Fresh interior paint & newly installed carpet. The kitchen is equipped with premium Viking appliances, including a double convection oven, gas cooktop, microwave, and dishwasher. The home also features an in-unit washer and dryer and a 2-car tandem parking garage. Easy maintained backyard with patio deck, great for BBQ & family gathering/relaxation. The community offers a two-acre park with a children's playground and a dog park. A must-see!
